# DSDM Copilot instructions

Follow `AGENTS.md`, `constitute.md`, and `consultation.md` for all repository tasks, including the approval gates and evidence requirements. Treat these as repository governance, subject to higher-priority platform and user instructions.

For Jira work, use `.github/skills/jira-management/SKILL.md`. For Confluence work, use `.github/skills/confluence-management/SKILL.md`. Discover and use the authorized Atlassian MCP tools available in the current GitHub Copilot environment; do not assume the separate Python MCP bridge is installed.

Do not require an Anthropic extension, Claude model pin, Python runtime, or Pi runtime to operate GitHub Copilot agents. Never claim a Jira/Confluence update was performed without reading back the result. Keep changes within the user's requested scope.
